source.baseStandard:
1) 성상: 고유의 향미를 가지며 이미, 이취가 없는 흐린 노란 주황색의 분말을 함유한 투명 경질캡슐
2) 비타민 B1 : 표시량(12 mg/500mg)의 80~180%
3) 비타민 B2 : 표시량(1.4 mg/500mg)의 80~180%
4) 나이아신 : 표시량(150 mg/500mg)의 80~150%
5) 비타민 B6 : 표시량(15 mg/500mg)의 80~150%
6) 엽산 : 표시량(400 ug DFE/500mg)의 80~150%
7) 비타민 B12 : 표시량(2.4 ug/500mg)의 80~180%
8) 비타민 C : 표시량(100 mg/500mg)의 80~150%
9) 비타민 D: 표시량(10 ug/500mg)의 80~180%
10) 비타민 E : 표시량(11 mg/500mg)의 80~150%
11) 대장균군: 음성
12) 붕해시험: 20분 이내
source.caution:
1) 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
2) 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
3) 과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의할 것
4) 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담할 것
5) 손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것

Health Functional FoodNiacin 150mgVitamin B1 12mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 15mgVitamin C 100mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin E 11mgFolate 400μgOnce a day

듀오랩 오렌지 멀티비타민Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Folate

Made by (주)쎌바이오텍 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 150mg of Niacin, 12mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 15mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 400μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 150mg Niacin, 12mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 15mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 400μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)쎌바이오텍

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water
